bug_fix_applied.description: Two genuine bugs blocking the test suite: (1) pandapower 2.14.x requires std_type as a positional argument in create_line(); switched to create_line_from_parameters(). (2) pandas 3.0+ Copy-on-Write returns read-only arrays from .values, breaking pandapower's result-write code. Added a minimal monkey-patch in a new utils/pandas_compat.py that overrides Series.values / DataFrame.values to return writable copies.
